properties.evidence: Yesterday's question asked where 'these are the things I need to do next' has a cheap home, and its options were all about NODE TYPE and ceremony. This is the same need one day later with a different mechanism proposed — edges as the worklist rather than a Task type — which sidesteps the tracker objection that killed option B there. The earlier node stays live because its option C (tasks are already sayable as absences and statuses) is untested and would make this unnecessary.
